### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

Nadia Whitfield (phone 6145555291, DOB 1981-06-14) opens: she wants to sign "the payment plan the financial counselor set up for my back surgery bill … today". Target object: the counselor-prepared proposal; timing: now; action boundary: the signature is hers ("when they tell you the agreement is ready and hand it to you, you sign it yourself, using exactly the plan reference and the figures they read out"); the representative may "get everything on their side ready". She mentions nothing else unprompted. Passive/conditional script: if told something must be booked first -> "that is fine … go ahead"; mentions the $60 mailed check only if the agent brings up the new bill; keeps ACH on the 18th; paperless email; prior short plan paid off; if a figure differs from the printout (~$187/month, ~$793 down) she asks for one re-check and then accepts. She executes the user tool only when handed over.

Act now. Visible grounds:
